description: Set or clear the workspace webhook destination after explicit permission to share future mailing/credit events with that HTTPS destination. Pass confirmed:true and url (empty clears). Uses website public-destination validation. Requires production write access. Saving a nonempty destination creates a strong signing secret if none is usable. Retrieve the secret in the authenticated website Developers screen to configure the receiver; MCP never returns it. Does not send a test. Workspace authentication required.
name: update_webhook_settings

outputSchema.description: Read operation first for financial/mail state and recovery. Optional service fields are absent on failure. Unknown is not zero or permission to retry. Legacy service fields remain available.

amountCents.description: USD cents. Null means not applicable or not known; never interpret null as zero.

title: Update Webhook Settings
